candidate_merges.message: Make WithBindMount idempotent and fail fast on conflicting mount targets (#21546) ## Description `WithBindMount` always appended a new `ContainerMountAnnotation`, even when the resource already had a mount at that target. Duplicates went straight to DCP, and Docker refused to create the container with `Duplicate mount point: <target>`.
